argument-label.comment: Swift's grammar scopes an argument label (alignment:, spacing:, systemImage:) as support.function.any-method.swift - the very same scope it gives the call itself (VStack, Text). Only position tells them apart: a label sits after '(' or ',' and before ':'.

object-reference.comment: Capitalised head of a member chain (Color.red, Task.sleep) - matches the Kotlin/Flutter treatment.

modifier-call.comment: SwiftUI modifiers (.padding, .font, .background) and view constructors (HStack, Text) share the scope support.function.any-method.swift. A modifier is preceded by a dot; a constructor is not.
